create_quaternion_from_values: create a quaternion from x, y, z, w values using the Create function
build_euler_to_quaternion: build a quaternion from Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) using the Euler function
multiply_quaternions_and_vectors: multiply two quaternions or rotate a vector by a quaternion using Multiply
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a quaternion to a 3x3 rotation matrix using the ToMatrix function
create_quaternion_from_angle_axis: create a quaternion from an angle and rotation axis using the AngleAxis function
